trap.label: preposição
trap.why: To em object to é preposição. O brasileiro usa o infinitivo por analogia com “opor-se a pagar”.

fix.wrong: They are opposed to turn off.
fix.right: They are opposed to turning it off.

fix.wrong: He objects to pay the bill.
fix.right: He objects to paying the bill.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “I don’t agree with turning it off.” (object to)
rewrite.answer: I object to turning it off.
